items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh yeah, I play with them a lot. I could have been a member of John's band right now

ctx.x: You never play much with the Young Tuxedo Brass Band? Who me?
Yeah. Play much with them? Oh yeah, I play with them a lot. I could have been a member of John's band right now, but after, I told John I couldn't do all that walking. I was loving, sir.
What about the people out in California? What do you think about them? People? When they listen to the music.
